messages:
Elaine: Kickoff: Quasar Health POC perf run. Goal: prove mixed workload 1.5k sustained qps on /v1/chat with p99 < 250ms for their typical mix. They want burst resiliency, warmup behavior, and a short pricing sketch. Proposed window: Mon 08:30 PT, 90m.

Rob: I can take load harness + runbook. Need payload split and whether to exercise streaming vs non-streaming paths. Also any BYOK/HSM ask?

Elaine: Payload: 65% short (20-40 tokens), 30% medium (80-160), 5% long (300-600). Streaming ratio 1:3. Auth: hosted run with API key; prospect asked about HSM for Dedicated later. Security questionnaire due EOD Mon.

Michael: Ops notes: staging pool has 3x A10G reserved Mon 07:00-10:00. Can request 5x for the window if approved. Private HSM import takes ~48-72h. Hosted KMS envelope + customer BYOK is doable if they accept envelope keys.

Rob: Proposed runs:
- Ramp to 1.5k over 10m, hold 40m steady
- Short bursts: three 30s spikes to 4.5k qps with 3m recovery between
- Session churn: spawn 6k new sessions in 10m to measure KV cache warm-up
I'll use vegeta for the qps sweeps and a small Go-based streaming client for SSE paths.

Rob: vegeta snippet (placeholder):
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -rate=1500 -duration=40m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type='hdr'
```
We'll tag requests with X-Run-ID and include cost headers for token accounting.

Elaine: Acceptance criteria: p99(short+med) <=250ms steady, error rate <0.4%, tail recovery <120s after bursts, and sustained throughput within 7% of target for steady window. Capture p50/p90/p99, errors, and tokenized cost.

security: Heads-up on questionnaire items: key rotation, KMS/HSM proof (FIPS level), audit log retention, VPC peering diagram, and SOC2 report. If they require HSM import, we must escalate 48h+ lead time.

infra-bot: Reservation request submitted for 2 additional A10G for Mon 06:30-10:30 PT. Pending approval.

Michael: Capacity approved for 5x A10G. If we hit GPU saturation, we'll throttle by model-shard fallback. Also enable kernel-level tracing for postmortem.

Rob: I'll push runbook + scripts to perf/quasar and post link here when done. Also preparing a tokens->$ cost quick calc: sample: 1.5k qps * avg 70 tokens/request * 3600s = 378M tokens/hour (rough).

Elaine: For pricing messaging: show hosted on-demand estimate, and example Dedicated commit that reduces unit cost by ~40% at 3-6mo commit. Call out burst overage rates.

Rob: Pre-run checklist: tracing headers set, request sampling 100% for run, dashboards ready (p50/p90/p99, qps, errors, GPU util). Will post checklist 24h before.

Elaine: Great. React with :white_check_mark: when tasks done.

Rob: :white_check_mark: initial scripts pushed, validating payload distribution now.

Michael: :white_check_mark: capacity live and kernel tracing enabled for the window.

security: :white_check_mark: security Q draft posted to the doc and sent to sales for review.

Elaine: Thanks all 94 we'll record results & attach post-run writeup here.
